annotationRationale: The question tests taking a fraction of a remaining quantity. Converting between percentages and fractions supports the calculation.

classificationReview.areaCheck: Prealgebra is appropriate; no area repair is needed.

review.questionCheck: The remainder is 30% of the whole pie, of which two thirds remains after Maria's share: 20%, choice C. The stem, choices, and key agree; no figures or grading contradictions are supplied.
review.alternativeMethodCheck: No shared-bank methods are supplied. AoPS Solutions 1 and 3 multiply the remainder by two thirds, an equivalent calculation to the retained subtraction route. Another method is unnecessary.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_p179 appropriately assesses taking a fraction of the remainder; cnm_p195 supports the explicitly written percentage/fraction conversions. No contextual nodes are needed.
review.areaCheck: Prealgebra is appropriate; no area repair is needed.

methodReviews.mathCheck: Carlos leaves 3/10 of the pie. Maria takes (1/3)(3/10)=1/10, leaving 3/10−1/10=1/5=20%. Every conversion and subtraction is correct.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: The argument matches LIVE and AoPS Solution 2, and both references are credited. source-informed-original correctly identifies their nonofficial status. The motivation and fraction conversions provide an independently expressed explanation.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: The opening explains why to find the remainder first. Each percentage is clearly measured against the whole pie, preventing confusion about Maria's share.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: Both supplied node definitions match operations actually shown; neither is an unsupported broad topic.
